fine_segments_omission_reason: 161-segment mesh for 256 elements (41,216 NEC-2 unknowns, ~27.18 GB per dense complex128 matrix copy) exceeded the 53.5 GiB virtual-memory cap during nec_factor_factrs_openmp; approved decision is to package the 81-segment mesh only.
interpretation: 256-element bundle uses the 81-segment NEC-2 discretization only (161-segment extraction omitted under the 53.5 GiB memory cap); 64- and 128-element 81-vs-161 mesh deltas (< 0.88% relative Frobenius, ~0.25% median diagonal) provide the supporting discretization sensitivity trend.
